Everything still begins below y≈430: the left two-thirds above the cap and the right column above the logo band (y=497) are empty pale field, roughly 30% of the canvas, so the asymmetric grid lacks the upper counterweight (caustic glow, tonal drift) that references 1 and 3 use to activate negative space; the frame reads bottom-weighted.

The column rhythm is still uneven: logo band ends y=517, title starts y=576 (59px gap), title ends y=768, subtitle starts y=820 (52px gap), subtitle ends y=839 then a 45px gap to the 150px rule at y=884; against the confident single-lockup columns in references 1-2 the four fragments still feel spaced by increment rather than set as one lockup.

The ice/sky tonal break renders at y≈830-850 (mid-frame), not in the low band the concept declares; the bottle correctly stands on a foreground ice plane (contact detail crop [88,1156,605,1406] confirms an absorbed contact shadow, no floating), but the mid-height horizon behind the title block keeps the upper field a flat empty wall rather than the vast mist sky with drifting caustic light the brief describes.
